english.meaning: to leave someone or something; to be apart from
english.note: 離你而去 means 'to leave you'.

exampleSentences.english: Oh well, Elton has left me.
exampleSentences.traditional: 算喇，艾爾頓離我而去嚹噉就。
exampleSentences.jyutping: syun3 laa1 aai6 ji5 deon6 lei4 ngo5 ji4 heoi3 laa3 gam2 zau6

exampleSentences.english: That’s right—Elton should leave you too by now.
exampleSentences.traditional: 都啱𠸏，艾爾頓都應該係時候離你而去嚹。
exampleSentences.jyutping: dou1 aam1 ge2 aai6 ji5 deon6 dou1 jing1 goi1 hai6 si4 hau6 lei4 nei5 ji4 heoi3 laa3
